gen-dafont-sf-wonder-comic-satoshi: Satoshi reads tall and friendly, every stroke cut to a single width. SF Wonder Comic packs dense, tall words with half-open bowls, so the page gets one loud voice and one steady one.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-epunda-slab: Wide-spaced and dreamy, Starborn drifts across the line in a thick, dark stripe. Epunda Slab grounds it all with classic serif dignity, its tall rounded lowercase and gaping c holding the drift in place.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-hanuman: Starlit and spacious, Starborn lets its dark lowercase stripe float between wide gaps. Hanuman, a refined serif with a high-waisted lowercase, keeps paragraphs feeling traditional and unhurried as the lines pile up.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noticia-text: Dreamy and gappy, Starborn is all atmosphere in a dark lowercase stripe. Noticia Text does the opposite job, a dignified serif whose big curved entrances and full-height lowercase carry the actual reading.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla is a refined, authoritative serif whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals, with an e pried open like a clasp. Starborn adds the dreamy, gap-filled drift on top, dark and loose.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-pridi: Starborn scatters wide gaps between its letters and lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through each line. Pridi keeps paragraphs feeling classic and refined, its proud small letters nearly capital-sized.
gen-dafont-starborn-instrument-sans: Dreamy gaps between its letters give Starborn a drifting look, with a thick dark stripe of lowercase. Instrument Sans stays modern and crisp beside it, its stroke weight never varying.
gen-dafont-starborn-inter: Hazy and wide-gapped, Starborn runs a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line. Inter, a smooth monoline sans-serif with big breathing counters, is what holds the pair together.
gen-dafont-starborn-rubik: Dreamy and weightless, Starborn leaves big gaps between its letters, then stripes each line dark. Rubik is the soft, clean sans-serif underneath, with big lowercase and round shapes that stay legible small.
gen-dafont-stencilia-fs-bespoke-sans: Stencilia opens spacious gaps at its curve terminals while keeping the ascender line compactly close to the x-height. Bespoke Sans, sharp and refined, works nicely at a smaller size.
